g.text: authenticate bearer; derive user from token
check joined membership, Megolm and call power >= 10
validate OpenID proof using local userinfo
check joined membership, Megolm and call power >= 10
recheck room state and call permission
return candidate only if still authorized
This diagram describes token authorization and signaling.
It does not establish successful media transport, client
compatibility, or ringing. Test audio/video, NAT, firewall,
and TURN behavior for the selected clients and deployment.
Other public JWT mint routes are denied. The federation
get_token route is not exposed in this single-homeserver demo.
Synapse's standalone OpenID userinfo route is narrowly exposed
for proof validation; the general federation API is not enabled.
